messages:
maria (eng-releases): Kicking off regional rollout preflight. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, 10% canary per region, 30m hold. deploy-bot: rolling canary to us-west-1 (slice=canary-10) starting now.
deploy-bot: warmup tasks: attach warm pool, prefetch KV caches, apply quant profile v3.1.
sam (oncall): quick capacity check — what headroom do we have for sustained 95th p50 tokens/sec in US?
ashwin (eng-infra): US pool current spare GPUs: 6 full cards (~180k TUs/hr). With current QPS we have ~40% cushion for canary+10% ramp.
lina (sre): +1 on numbers, but thermal margin only ~12% on a couple racks in us-east-2. Recommend soft-thermostat set to conservative for first 15m.
maria (eng-releases): noted. set thermostat? command?
ashwin (eng-infra): run: `deployctl set-thermostat us-east-2 --mode conservative --duration 15m`
kevin (product): any EU compliance pinning required? We had requests to keep EU model pinned to v2.3.9 for log format compatibility.
jess (ml): EU can run v2.4.x but output schema changed; we need rollout flag. If EU customers are pinned, we should avoid automatic fallback to v2.4.x.
maria (eng-releases): decision: keep EU pinned to v2.3.9 for this wave. deploy-bot: pin applied.
maria (eng-releases): EU pin command used: `deploybot pin --region eu-west-1 --version v2.3.9 --reason "schema compatibility"`
oliver (support): noted, will add note to release notes: "EU remains on v2.3.9 — see known schema delta"
sam (oncall): what are rollback triggers? latency >200ms p95 for 3 consecutive 5m windows? error rate >1% user-facing?
lina (sre): propose concrete triggers: p95 >200ms for 10m OR 0.8% 5xx affecting >1% of user requests. If triggered, immediate pin back to prior version and divert traffic to fallback pool.
maria (eng-releases): add to runbook. deploy-bot: smoke test triggered in US canary: 50 synthetic requests — 49/50 OK, median latency 82ms, p95 140ms.
jess (ml): quality smoke: short prompt evals passed 94% of golden set. No hallucination spike.
nashwin (eng-infra): monitoring hooks active: tracing, token-cost counters, KV hit-rate metrics.
kevin (product): release notes draft attached in the thread doc; small breaking change listed under dev notes.
maria (eng-releases): timeline check — US holdpoint ends in 30m, if stable we'll open EU to 10% canary (but pinned to v2.3.9). Then APAC warmup scheduled in 2h.
sam (oncall): I'll watch the heatmap and runbook alerts. ping me if any OOM or thermal events.
oliver (support): I'll prepare canned messages for customers in APAC in case of early rollback.
lina (sre): one more ask — let's enable automatic short-circuit fallback: `deploybot set-fallback --region us --target dedicated-fallback --thresholds p95:200ms:10m,5xx:0.8%`
maria (eng-releases): done. deploy-bot: fallback policy applied for us-west-1.
kevin (product): +:thumbsup: good coordination.
maria (eng-releases): final note: keep EU pin in release notes and ops doc. If we see any regression in US during hold, immediate rollback plan executed and EU/APAC waves paused.
deploy-bot: canary completed for us-west-1 slice=canary-10; status=healthy; rollout paused at holdpoint.
